morphology.formula: ∅ + baldi → baldi（水桶；借词整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 同步构词中视为完整词根，不拆成 bal 与 -di；bal.di 为两个音节。

senses.zh_definition: 水桶；通常带有提柄、用于盛水或浸泡衣物等的容器，常以金属或塑料制成。
senses.en_definition: A bucket or pail, usually with a carrying handle, used for holding water or soaking laundry.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis bekas bertangkai yang dibuat daripada zink atau plastik yang digunakan untuk mengisi air, merendam pakaian cucian dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 指容器本身；一桶水通常说 sebaldi air。baldi 是马来西亚日常常用词；具体容器不必只用于盛水，也可按用途装其他物品。

collocations.en: to fill a bucket with water

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak pengurusan menyediakan baldi dan peralatan pembersihan untuk kegunaan petugas.
dual_scenarios.zh: 管理方为工作人员提供水桶和清洁用具。
dual_scenarios.en: Management provides buckets and cleaning equipment for staff use.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Baldi biru tu ada kat bilik air ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah baldi biru itu berada di bilik air?
dual_scenarios.en: Is the blue bucket in the bathroom?
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式
kat 相当于地点介词 di
句末 ke 表示口语询问

messages.speaker: Farah (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Baldi biru tu ada kat bilik air ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah baldi biru itu berada di bilik air?
messages.en: Is the blue bucket in the bathroom?

messages.speaker: Amir (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ada, aku dah basuh tadi. Ambil je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, baldi itu ada di sana dan saya sudah membasuhnya tadi. Silakan ambil.
messages.zh: 在，我刚洗过了，你拿去用吧。
messages.en: Yes, I washed it earlier. Go ahead and take it.

etymology.historical_story: Baldi is generally traced to Portuguese balde, meaning bucket. It belongs to a wider history of vocabulary exchanged around maritime Asia, where related bucket words occur in several languages. A dictionary of Kristang, the Portuguese creole associated with Malacca, also records baldi. That parallel illustrates the contact setting, although it does not establish the exact route into Malay. [Loanword study](https://irgu.unigoa.ac.in/drs/bitstream/handle/unigoa/3681/sardesai_m_2006.pdf?sequence=1); [Kristang dictionary](https://openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au/server/api/core/bitstreams/b9f4de02-19d2-4b1d-b643-5db3308f9ef9/content).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bal-di：想象提着桶“把地”冲洗干净，把声音与清洁用的水桶连起来；这是谐音记忆，不是词源拆分。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 中性日常用品名称，无特殊称谓限制；向别人借用时可说 Boleh saya pinjam baldi ini?。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于家庭、宿舍、清洁及工作场景。借用时说明用途，尤其不要将他人专用于洗衣或清洁的桶擅自用于装食物。
